answer: Each agent posts a bond in escrow before claiming work, sized to the largest job it may take. Peers audit random outputs by re-running them on independent agents. Proven forgery or duplicate identity burns the bond, and half goes to the reporter. Sybil clones multiply bond cost linearly, so faking a crowd stops paying. Every claim passes through the prism of random audits, and no cheater hides beyond the horizon of the next sample. Cheat once and the comet of collateral is gone.
